remarks: Long-term rental opportunity in the heart of Old Greenwich, directly overlooking the prestigious Innis Arden Golf Club. 80 Tomac Avenue offers a unique blend of privacy, open golf course views, and an unbeatable in-town location just minutes to Old Greenwich Village, Metro North, and Greenwich Point Park. This 4 bedroom, 2.1 bath home features sun-filled interiors and a seamless layout ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Generous living spaces, well proportioned bedrooms, and inviting outdoor areas enhance the home's appeal. Opportunities like this are rarely available. Enjoy the best of Old Greenwich living with space, setting, and convenience all in one.
